content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The geographic exclusion that creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Bangladesh face from conventional payment platforms is systemic, not incidental. PayPal, Stripe, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy all operate within the traditional financial system, subject to the same correspondent banking relationships and AML compliance requirements that make international money movement difficult in certain corridors. Blockchain-based payments operate outside this system entirely. A USDT transaction from a buyer in Germany to a seller in Lagos does not pass through any correspondent bank. It does not require a compliance officer to approve the transaction corridor. It settles peer-to-peer, on-chain, in under 60 seconds.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need to set up a GitHub Pages site to host your ebooks, a Cloudflare Pages site to handle payments, and a NOWPayments account to process transactions. You'll also need to configure your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account to deliver ebooks to customers. Don't worry, we'll walk you through each step in this guide.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Pages site and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account. This will allow you to accept payments in cryptocurrency and deliver ebooks to customers instantly. You can choose from over 300 cryptocurrencies supported by NOWPayments, including USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.
You can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies supported by NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. You'll need to test your infrastructure to ensure that it's working correctly and that you can deliver your ebooks instantly to customers. We recommend using Binance P2P to test your payment setup and ensure that you can receive payments in Kenyan shillings, cedis, or naira.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is running smoothly, it's time to scale your business and increase sales.
